query:
INSERT INTO usr (workspace_id, username, email, is_admin, operator)
         SELECT $1::varchar, u.username, u.email, true, false FROM usr u
         WHERE u.workspace_id = $2 AND u.email = $3 AND u.is_admin AND NOT u.operator AND NOT u.disabled
           AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM password p WHERE p.email = u.email AND p.disabled)
           AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM usr f WHERE f.workspace_id = $1::varchar AND f.email = $3)
         ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
         RETURNING username
